spans.s: --the sea of clouds surrounding the अण्ड, supported by the ever-blazing energy (fire) of clouds (ghana- tejas) like the burning iron rod; outside is a vast region sup- ported by Ghana वात, which rests again on आकाश. The last is supported by महत्, प्रधान being a prop to महत्। Br. II. २१. २४-7; वा. ४९. १५३-55; ५०. ८२-4.
